desc:
MULTIPACK: Contains 4- 18oz of Oat Crunch Chocolate Cereal, Gluten Free Large Size Boxes + 1 Utility Freebie by Lavinia

TASTY: Cheerios Oat Crunch Chocolate Flavored Cereal has a little crunch that goes a long way. This delicious cereal, with a crave-able crunch, helps keep you full through the morning. Start your day satisfied with a bowl of this sweetened multigrain cereal, which includes whole-grain oats and cocoa, as part of a balanced breakfast.

HEALTHY: Good source of calcium / Gluten free / No artificial colors or flavors / No high fructose corn syrup

GLUTEN-FREE; We know that lots of different families want to enjoy Cheerios together. That’s why we worked hard to remove stray wheat, rye, and barley grains from our oat supply.

Healthy Hearts: Cheerios has soluble fiber from whole-grain oats, which can help lower cholesterol as part of a heart-healthy diet.
features:
Key Features:

Chocolate-Flavored Oat Cereal: Combines the wholesome goodness of Cheerios with real cocoa for a rich, chocolatey taste.

Made with Whole Grain Oats: Delivers 21g of whole grains per serving to support a balanced diet.

Gluten-Free: Safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities or those following a gluten-free lifestyle.

No Artificial Flavors: Naturally flavored and free from artificial ingredients.

Fortified with Nutrients: Includes 12 essential vitamins and minerals like iron, calcium, and vitamin D.

Benefits:

Heart-Healthy: Contains soluble fiber from oats, which may help reduce cholesterol as part of a heart-healthy diet.

Kid-Friendly Flavor: Sweet, chocolatey taste that appeals to kids while still offering nutritional value.

Versatile: Great as a breakfast cereal, dry snack, or dessert topping.

Quick and Easy: A convenient option for busy mornings or on-the-go snacks.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch, Salt, Blueberry Powder, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Tripotassium Phosphate, Strawberry Powder, Cranberry Powder
